meta_description: Birmingham Plastering and Decorating Co. specialises in interior and exterior plastering, skimming, and decorating across Birmingham. Free quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Skilled Plasterers & Decorators — Quality Finishes Guaranteed
hero_subhead: From cracked walls to full room renovations, we deliver smooth, lasting finishes on time and on budget.
services_heading: Complete Plastering & Decorating Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: We handle everything from minor patch repairs to full interior makeovers, using only quality materials and proven techniques.

services.title: Internal Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Professional plasterboard fixing, skimming, and finishing on walls and ceilings. Creates flawless surfaces ready for decoration, perfect for new builds or renovation projects.

services.title: Artex Removal & Re-skimming
services.desc: Safe removal of textured ceilings followed by smooth re-skimming. Transforms dated rooms and brings ceilings up to modern standards.

services.title: Exterior Rendering
services.desc: Durable cement or silicone-based renders for exposed brick, concrete, or older walls. Protects your property whilst giving a clean, fresh appearance.

services.title: Patch Repairs & Damage
services.desc: Quick fixes for cracked plaster, water damage, or accidental holes. We blend repairs seamlessly so they're invisible once decorated.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Professional painting and wallpapering following our plastering work. Includes surface preparation, priming, and two-coat finishes in your chosen colours.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Polished plaster, Venetian finishes, and textured effects for a bespoke look. Adds character and depth to feature walls or commercial spaces.

about_pullquote: We measure our success by how invisible our work becomes once it's painted.
about_para_1: The Birmingham Plastering and Decorating Co. was founded in 2006 by plasterers frustrated with corner-cutting in the trade. Over 18 years, we've built a reputation for meticulous surface preparation and finishes that last. Based in Quinton, we've completed over 1,200 projects across Birmingham and the surrounding areas, working with homeowners, landlords, and builders alike.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our obsession with detail. We don't rush preparation—proper undercoats, sanding, and priming mean your decoration stays looking fresh for years. Our customers return to us because we turn up on time, explain what we're doing, and leave sites clean. We're not the cheapest, but we're worth every penny.

reviews.text: Had our entire lounge re-plastered and decorated. The team was brilliant—professional, tidy, and finished bang on schedule. The walls are perfectly smooth and the finish is outstanding. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend them.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Rang them up about a water-damaged ceiling and they were out within two days. Sorted the plaster, re-skimmed the whole thing, and even matched the emulsion perfectly. Brilliant service and fair pricing. Already booked them for the bathroom.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Used them for rendering our 1970s semi. They explained every step, sourced quality materials, and the finish looks ten times better than what was there. Professional outfit—you can see they take pride in their work.
reviews.author: Michael T.
